execution_rules.positive_inputs: Match case input components to the run input; all applies to all non-brief runs, with app filtering.
execution_rules.native: Run native cases only within recorded native scope; not-requested and unvisited routes are not verified.
execution_rules.compound_cases: All named state/subcase variants need evidence. One sampled variant cannot pass the compound case.
execution_rules.not_applicable: Record a reason before execution; mandatory requested behavior cannot be marked not-applicable merely because unsupported.
execution_rules.affected_scope: If source/component dependency coverage is missing or uncertain, rerun all app routes.
execution_rules.effect_controls: TC-I01/I04/I08/I11-I14 require current paired evidence. Reuse an existing baseline/singleton only if all other input bytes, seed, source revision and environment match; otherwise rerender the control. Control rerenders are additional to 16 input runs.

source_delivery.rule: Record actual delivery channel and original attachment metadata/path/hash. A synthetic agent/local fixture never proves host chat attachment UX. Unavailable host attachment execution stays unverified without blocking independent local-file tests.

execution_reconciliation.meaning: Partial actual execution is recorded per case; only every mandatory applicable variant/run with current evidence can close a case.
execution_reconciliation.evidence_distribution: Owner-local actual browser/Figma receipts are excluded from distribution; relative paths and hashes identify those witnesses, not portable proof supplied to fork users. Re-execution is required when unavailable.
execution_reconciliation.supplemental_scope: Coffee Notes normal photo/font browser/Figma evidence is a separate two-state fixture, not full completion of TC-I02 or the40-route program.
